description.en: A name refers to a value. Assignment can change which value that name refers to; its exact rules depend on the language.
description.zh: 名称指向一个值。赋值可以改变名称所指的值；具体规则由语言决定。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: A type describes permitted values and operations. A parser can show an annotation without proving every value matches it.
description.zh: 类型描述允许的值与操作。解析器能显示类型标注，但这不等于已证明所有值都符合标注。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: Scope determines where a name can be used. A nearby declaration can hide a name from an outer scope.
description.zh: 作用域决定名称在哪些位置可用。内部声明可能遮蔽外部同名名称。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: A function groups operations that can be invoked by name or value. Its declaration is evidence of structure, not of its business purpose.
description.zh: 函数把可调用的操作组织在一起。函数声明提供结构证据，但不能单独证明业务目的。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: A parameter names an input accepted by a function. An argument is the expression supplied at a particular call.
description.zh: 形参命名函数接收的输入；实参是某次调用传入的表达式。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: A return statement can end a function and provide a result. A missing explicit return has language-specific meaning.
description.zh: 返回语句可以结束函数并提供结果。没有显式返回语句时的行为取决于语言。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: An expression computes or denotes a value. Static syntax identifies its parts; the resulting value may require runtime inputs.
description.zh: 表达式计算或表示一个值。静态语法能识别组成部分；最终值可能依赖运行时输入。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: A condition selects a path according to a test. Both paths can appear in a static graph even when only one runs.
description.zh: 条件根据判断选择执行路径。静态图中可能同时存在两条路径，尽管某次运行只经过其中一条。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: A loop repeats a region according to an iterator or condition. Its number of iterations is not generally known from syntax alone.
description.zh: 循环根据迭代器或条件重复一段代码。仅靠语法通常无法知道循环次数。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: A class organizes members and can describe objects. Member syntax does not by itself resolve which runtime object receives a call.
description.zh: 类组织成员，也可描述对象。成员语法本身不能确定运行时哪个对象接收调用。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: An interface describes a contract that implementations satisfy. A declared contract differs from evidence that behavior was tested.
description.zh: 接口描述实现需要满足的约定。声明约定与测试验证行为属于不同证据。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: Inheritance relates a derived type to a base type. Dynamic method selection may need information beyond the syntax tree.
description.zh: 继承关联派生类型与基类型。动态方法选择可能需要语法树之外的信息。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: Error handling provides an explicit path for unsuccessful operations. Languages may use exceptions, result values or both.
description.zh: 错误处理为未成功操作提供明确路径。语言可能使用异常、结果值，或同时使用两者。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: A collection stores multiple values. Its ordering, lookup cost and mutation rules depend on the particular data structure.
description.zh: 集合存储多个值。顺序、查找成本与修改规则取决于具体数据结构。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: An algorithm is a finite description of steps for a task. Identifying a familiar code shape suggests a pattern, not a proof of correctness.
description.zh: 算法是完成任务的一组有限步骤描述。识别熟悉的代码形状可以提示模式，但不能证明正确性。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: Complexity describes how resource use grows with input size. A loop's presence alone does not establish a complete cost bound.
description.zh: 复杂度描述资源使用随输入规模增长的方式。仅看到循环不能得出完整成本上界。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: A module groups declarations under a boundary. Imports expose relationships between modules without running imported code during analysis.
description.zh: 模块在边界内组织声明。导入展示模块关系；分析时无需运行被导入代码。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: A dependency records that one element relies on another. An edge's kind and direction explain what kind of reliance was observed or inferred.
description.zh: 依赖记录一个元素对另一个元素的依靠。边的类型与方向说明依靠关系的观察或推断方式。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: A call chain follows resolved calls from one callable to another. It describes a possible static relationship, not an execution recording.
description.zh: 调用链沿已解析调用连接多个可调用对象。它表示可能的静态关系，并非执行记录。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: An API defines how software elements interact. A function signature may be one part of an API; access rules and behavior also matter.
description.zh: API 定义软件元素如何交互。函数签名可能是其中一部分；访问规则与行为同样重要。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: HTTP exchanges requests and responses between participants. Syntax may reveal a route or method without proving deployment behavior.
description.zh: HTTP 在参与方之间交换请求与响应。语法可能揭示路由或方法，但不能证明部署行为。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: A database stores organized data for querying and updates. A database-related name alone does not prove storage semantics or transaction safety.
description.zh: 数据库存储可查询、可更新的结构化数据。仅有数据库相关名称不能证明存储语义或事务安全。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: Asynchronous code can suspend work while awaiting a result. An await expression does not by itself imply that tasks run in parallel.
description.zh: 异步代码能在等待结果时暂停当前工作。await 表达式本身不代表任务并行执行。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: Concurrency permits multiple tasks to make progress over overlapping periods. Shared mutable state requires coordination whose correctness is not established by a call graph.
description.zh: 并发允许多个任务在重叠时间段推进。共享可变状态需要协调；调用图不能单独证明其正确性。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: Synchronization constrains when tasks access resources or observe results. Lock syntax reveals a mechanism, while deadlock freedom needs stronger analysis.
description.zh: 同步协调约束任务何时访问资源或观察结果。锁语法展示机制；无死锁需要更强分析。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: Recursion occurs when a callable reaches itself directly or through other calls. Termination depends on conditions and input, not merely graph cycles.
description.zh: 可调用对象直接或间接调用自身时形成递归。是否终止依赖条件与输入，而不只取决于图中的环。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: A test checks selected behavior under selected conditions. A passing test supports those checks and does not verify every relationship in a graph.
description.zh: 测试在选定条件下检查选定行为。通过测试支持这些检查，不能验证图中的全部关系。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: A component groups elements around an explicit responsibility or interface. Structural communities and business components are separate hypotheses with separate evidence.
description.zh: 组件围绕明确职责或接口组织元素。结构社区与业务组件是不同假设，应分别记录证据。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: Architecture describes major elements, boundaries and their relationships. A useful model states its evidence and the details it leaves unresolved.
description.zh: 架构描述主要元素、边界及其关系。有用的模型需要说明证据和仍未解析的细节。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: A strategy design separates a choice of behavior from the caller that uses it. Similar syntax is a candidate pattern until responsibilities are confirmed.
description.zh: 策略设计把行为选择与使用行为的调用方分开。相似语法只能提示候选模式，职责仍需确认。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: An observer design notifies registered listeners about changes. A callback registration is evidence of a mechanism, not proof of every delivery guarantee.
description.zh: 观察者设计向已注册监听者通知变化。回调注册提供机制证据，但不能证明所有交付保证。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: A factory centralizes object creation behind an operation. A function named create is not sufficient evidence that the design pattern is present.
description.zh: 工厂把对象创建集中到某个操作后方。名为 create 的函数不足以证明存在该设计模式。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: State is information retained across operations. An assignment shows a potential change; determining all later values may require runtime information.
description.zh: 状态是在操作之间保留的信息。赋值表明潜在变化；确定后续所有值可能需要运行时信息。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: A dependency cycle lets a directed path return to its starting node. It can complicate initialization or boundaries, but is not itself proof of a runtime failure.
description.zh: 循环依赖让有向路径回到起点。它可能增加初始化或边界复杂度，但本身不能证明运行时故障。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original text may be redistributed under MPL-2.0; reference pages are linked only and are not included.

description.en: A syntax node selects between paths; no claim is made about which path runs.
description.zh: 语法节点在路径之间选择；不声称某次运行经过哪条路径。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original prose; redistributable under MPL-2.0

description.en: Iteration syntax provides a repeated region; iteration counts remain unknown.
description.zh: 迭代语法提供重复区域；迭代次数保持未知。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original prose; redistributable under MPL-2.0

description.en: Error-handling syntax identifies an exceptional path or a propagation operation.
description.zh: 错误处理语法识别异常路径或传播操作。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original prose; redistributable under MPL-2.0

description.en: Callable declarations supply names, parameters and syntactic return sites.
description.zh: 可调用声明提供名称、参数与语法返回位置。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original prose; redistributable under MPL-2.0

description.en: Binding or assignment syntax indicates where state may be introduced or changed.
description.zh: 绑定或赋值语法指出可能引入或修改状态的位置。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original prose; redistributable under MPL-2.0

description.en: A call expression is syntactic evidence; target resolution is a separate step.
description.zh: 调用表达式属于语法证据；解析目标是独立步骤。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original prose; redistributable under MPL-2.0

description.en: Module syntax records a declared boundary or import, without executing it.
description.zh: 模块语法记录声明边界或导入，不执行代码。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original prose; redistributable under MPL-2.0

description.en: A type declaration groups data or members; runtime behavior remains unproven.
description.zh: 类型声明组织数据或成员；运行时行为仍未验证。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original prose; redistributable under MPL-2.0

description.en: Contract or implementation syntax is evidence of declared relationships.
description.zh: 约定或实现语法提供已声明关系的证据。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original prose; redistributable under MPL-2.0

description.en: An await site can suspend an operation; parallel execution is not implied.
description.zh: await 位置可暂停操作；不代表并行执行。

attribution.author: Glyphibe contributors
attribution.redistribution: Original prose; redistributable under MPL-2.0
